audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Jayce six of seven rows, against the mirror and against a 53.09% Warwick win rate.
audit.why: The mirror audit (jayce__warwick) re-set the sides to Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Warwick. The current chart also fought the page's own prose, which already said level 1-2 favours Warwick.
audit.corrected: Rows 2 through 6 flipped on both layers as one atomic group, ratings rescaled to 3/3/5/7/7/7/7, and whys[0], [1], [2], [3], [5], [6] rewritten to agree. diffRating dropped from 8.5/10 to 5/10 with the FAV tone, since 8.5/10 and a red tone contradicted a diff of FAV.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not a single cooldown on the page, and the first-item stage was described only as 'his poke keeps you low'.
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 and 6s at rank 6 — the punish window shrinks by ten seconds over the game, which is the actual spike. Thundering Blow is 20s at rank 1 and is his only peel. Primal Howl is 15s. And being kept low is not purely bad: Eternal Hunger heals below 50% of Warwick's own health and triples below 25%, so his poke walks you into your own scaling.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[0].why, phases[3].why, phases[5].why, phases[6].why, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, spikes[2], spikes[3], early, mid and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Primal Howl appears nowhere on the page.
audit.why: 2.5 seconds of damage reduction followed by a 1-second fear on a 15s cooldown is the ability that actually breaks a Hyper Charge burst in this lane. The mirror agent found it missing from their side too and made it the centrepiece of their level 4-5 rewrite.
audit.corrected: Named with its full effect and timer in whys[3], mid, phases[3].why, breakdown.cooldowns and breakdown.trading.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and wants.you[1] claim Infinite Duress 'ignores' Thundering Blow's knockback and Acceleration Gate's speed.
audit.why: Riot's text is silent on whether a displacement can break the suppression channel, and needsResearch is empty by design, so this is UNKNOWN. The mirror agent hit the identical claim on their page and explicitly left it alone.
audit.corrected: Both sentences left untouched. Recorded in unverified.

edits.before: Level 1-2 favors you as Jayce must go melee to contest CS.
edits.after: Level 1 is Jayce's — Shock Blast pokes from 600 and you have 365.

edits.before: Level 2 is even before both champs have their kits online.
edits.after: Level 2 is his too — weapon swap on 6s gives him free Move Speed.

edits.before: Level 3 your W-speed engage beats his short-cooldown melee form.
edits.after: Level 3 is skill — catch him in Hammer form and the trade is yours.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 tilt to Jayce as his ranged cannon combo out-pokes you.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 turn — Primal Howl's fear breaks the cannon-form combo.

edits.before: With first item Jayce's poke keeps you under your P heal threshold.
edits.after: At first item you hold — his poke drops you under 50%, where you heal.

edits.before: Late, Jayce's E knockback and burst kite and delete your engage.
edits.after: Late you hold — Jaws of the Beast scales off the health he stacks.

edits.before: After Jayce buys a component and gets his combo online, his Shock Blast through the E gate poke keeps you permanently below your P heal threshold.
edits.after: Shock Blast fired through Acceleration Gate gains speed, range and damage — but it pushes you under 50%, which is where Eternal Hunger starts healing.

edits.before: Jayce kites your engage with E knockback plus ranged Q, and his burst deletes you before Duress ends if he saves Thundering Blow to peel — respect the poke.
edits.after: Thundering Blow is 20s at rank 1 and knocks you back — that timer is the whole fight. Jaws of the Beast scales off his maximum health, so the stats he buys feed your bite.

edits.before: Level 1-2 you have the edge: Jayce has to commit melee Hammer form to trade CS with you, and your P bite plus base damage win that exchange.
edits.after: Level 1-2 belongs to Jayce: Shock Blast reaches 600 against your 365 lunge, and Hextech Capacitor gives him Move Speed on every weapon swap. Farm it out.

edits.before: Through the mid-levels it swings on his cannon poke — you dominate when you catch him in Hammer form or W-speed onto him, but level 4-5 tilts to Jayce as his ranged Shock Blast combo out-ranges everything you have until 6.
edits.after: Through the mid-levels it swings on his cannon poke, but 4-5 turns to you: Primal Howl gives 2.5s of damage reduction and then a 1s fear on a 15s timer, and that is what breaks a Hyper Charge burst. Catch him in Hammer form and the trade is free.

edits.before: After first item Jayce's poke and E knockback keep you out; you can only kill with an ult that beats his peel, otherwise perma-shove and let your jungle punish his low range.
edits.after: After first item his poke still keeps you out, but Jaws of the Beast deals max-health damage, so every stat he stacks works for you. Perma-shove and let your jungle punish his short escape.

edits.before: Your passive sustain wins extended level-1 auto wars. Identify how Jayce contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Shock Blast reaches 600 while Jaws of the Beast reaches 365, and every weapon swap hands him Move Speed — level 1 is his to poke.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Shock Blast's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Primal Howl is the turn: 2.5s of damage reduction into a 1s fear on a 15s timer, and it breaks a Hyper Charge burst outright.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Shock Blast's cooldown.
edits.after: His poke pushes you under 50% health — which is exactly where Eternal Hunger starts healing you.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Jayce carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, Jaws of the Beast scales off the health he stacks, and Thundering Blow is his only real peel at 20s at rank 1.

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — His main poke. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shock Blast: 16s at rank 1 down to 6s at rank 6 — the gap shrinks by ten seconds. - Thundering Blow: 20s at rank 1, his only peel. - Primal Howl: 15s, and it breaks his burst.
